dct_description_sm:
This point based dataset contains a directory of all of the places of worship within the Region of Peel, published to the Peel Data Centre.
The content was collected using internal databases and internet resources by Region of Peel Staff, and republished by the City of Brampton for convenience.
The dataset is not exhaustive, but it provides many of the places of worship that are in the Region.

The places of worship are broken into these religions:
  • Buddism
  • Christianity
  • Hinduism
  • Islam
  • Judaism
  • Sikhism
Source:https://data.peelregion.ca/datasets/places-of-worship
dct_title_s: Region of Peel Places of Worship
